messages:
jane-sales: Heads up — Acme POC kickoff this week. They added two new asks: low-latency <100ms (95p) for chat and vector-search on private infra. Need to confirm success criteria + pricing impact. Can we sync?
micah-ml-eng: Noted. Two quick Qs: 1) expected sustained qps and peak? 2) avg context length? 3) is EU VPC mandatory?
zaid-customer-eng: From customer: sustained ~30 qps, spikes to ~120. Typical context ~512 tokens. VPC required (EU region). They want evals: 50 golden prompts + 200 random queries.
toni-solutions: Adding vector-search + Private VPC pushes this to Dedicated. Also streaming/real-time rerank changes buffer/autoscale needs. We'll need to re-run pricing.
micah-ml-eng: Engineering notes: possible tradeoff = quantize (int8) to hit latency but with quality hit. Recommend we run evals on fp16 and int8 configs. Example eval prompt set snippet:
```
# golden prompt example
System: You are a concise assistant.
User: Summarize the policy changes in two bullets.
```
jane-sales: Can you draft the eval plan and a short change-control runbook? Customer may ask to include reranking experiments mid-POC.
micah-ml-eng: Quick perf estimate: int8 median latency ~85ms at qps=30 with continuous batching off. For spikes to 120 we'll need autoscale to +2 nodes (or pre-warm capacity). Config example for testing:
```json
{"model":"redwood-v2","quant":"int8","batching":"off","max_seq":512}
```
toni-solutions: I'll update the pricing worksheet. Security Qs: they require KMS + audit log retention. Private supports KMS; need to supply SOC2 artifact.
zaid-customer-eng: Customer also asked whether the 50 golden prompts can be included in our regression monitors and threshold alerts.
micah-ml-eng: Yes — we'll wire the golden set into the eval harness. Proposed success criteria: 1) 95th latency <=100ms for chat; 2) golden prompt F1 >=0.78 vs baseline; 3) uptime >=99.5% during POC; 4) vector recall@10 >=0.85.
jane-sales: Customer agreed to metrics but wants a 2-week extension to run reranking experiments. Do we accept the scope change?
micah-ml-eng: Tradeoffs: +2 weeks for index tuning, +1 dedicated GPU for peak sims. Recommend accept with updated SOW and pass infra cost to customer. I can provide infra numbers.
toni-solutions: I'll draft a change-order and cc legal + acct-team. Will attach SOW and updated estimate to the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-2421
deploy-bot: Ticket POC-2421 created by toni-solutions. Status: triage.
jane-sales: :thumbsup: I'll update the customer and propose kickoff Fri. Micah — can you deliver the eval harness by Thu EOD?
micah-ml-eng: Aiming for Thu EOD. If I hit infra blockers I'll ping eng-runtime and escalate.
